agyos_skill.instructions: The **offer-design layer** of the monetization cluster — design the magnet the capture paths deliver and the whole **social→capture→nurture** funnel that ties the cluster together. The agent designs + drafts; **WoopSocial has no landing/form/email/quiz builder** — it publishes the **promo posts**; capture/delivery/ nurture run in **external tools**. The 2018 gated-PDF play is fading — **AI assistants now answer what PDFs used to**, and ad-blockers/email apathy kill form-fills, so a "12-page Ultimate Guide" underperforms by 3–5×. What wins in 2026 is a **faster, more personal win**: **one audience, one problem, one quick win**, delivered as an **instant, interactive result** (quiz/calculator/assessment/generator/specific template — ~4× a static PDF), with a **short form**, a magnet **tied to your paid offer**, and — the most-missed part — the **whole funnel designed**, not just the magnet (landing → form → success page → delivery → a behavior-branched 3–5 email nurture). Nurtured leads are 50% more sales-ready at 33% less cost; 79% never convert without follow-up. 1. **brand-profile** — audience/pain + the paid offer the magnet connects to. 2. **goals-and-kpis** — the conversion goal the funnel serves. (Depth: `references/the-magnet-framework.md`.) - **M — Match to one audience + one problem** (one quick win; broad = converts no one). - **A — Anchor to the paid offer + the stage** (top = quiz/calculator; mid = template/benchmark; bottom = case study/ROI calc — so it qualifies, not just collects). - **G — Give an instant, interactive result** (on-the-spot beats "check your inbox"; ~4× a PDF). - **N — Name it for the outcome** (specific, outcome-focused title). - **E — Engineer the whole funnel** (benefit-first landing → short form [email/+first name] → success page → delivery → nurture; each extra field −5–10%). - **T — Tend the nurture** (deliver → quick win → proof → soft next step; **branch on behavior**, not just drip; don't pitch early).
